decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with its own page and two years of visible investment, management is likely to continue backing it and treat any underperformance as not yet decisive.

This decorative fabric has a lower public commitment than the page-led launches, but it still fits the established range and management would tend to keep it rather than reverse a recent collection decision.
Its own page, functional flame-retardant role and strong relevance for contract interiors make management especially reluctant to abandon it after having signaled commitment to the market.

E is the most vulnerable because it is a more specialized, less visibly committed extension, yet sunk development effort and the tendency to justify the existing collection still point to retaining it for now.
As the newest launch with its own page and clear fit across upholstery and curtains, it carries fresh investment and public commitment that strongly favor continuation.
